ib-suite 1.0.1

- No source or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Behavior, features, and onboarding remain unchanged from the previous version.

ib-suite 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides a read-only index and onboarding guide for the Interactive Brokers (IB) toolchain.
- Offers clear, step-by-step first-run setup for virtual environment and configuration, supporting live and paper accounts (read-only).
- Explains how to install and orchestrate sub-skills: data ingestion, account/positions/option overviews, Flex trade/dividend history, and offline analysis.
- Ensures no order placement/modification/cancellation is possible anywhere in this suite.
- Lists and describes each included sub-skill, with pointers on when to use each.
- Emphasizes safe, workspace-local storage for configuration and output data.

Initial release of ib-suite: a read-only index and onboarding tool for the Interactive Brokers toolchain.

- Provides an index and onboarding flow for the set of read-only IB diagnostic and reporting sub-skills.
- Ensures first-run setup: manages virtualenv bootstrap and guides generation of a workspace-local config (live or paper mode), without running any sub-skill itself.
- Documents the purpose, directory structure, and execution order of all sub-skills (ib-sync, reporting, history, options, etc.).
- Enforces and documents strict read-only scope—never places, modifies, or cancels orders; connects with readonly=True.
- Guides users to the appropriate sub-skill for their needs and lists what each component does.
- Centralizes onboarding and configuration, keeping user data and config local and outside the distributed skill code.
